verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Teller returns verified ACH details, ownership, and balances (teller-docs-1, teller-docs-22), and it can send Zelle payments itself. Nothing documents processor partner integrations or a token-exchange mechanism that hands verified account credentials to third-party processors or platforms. Raw ACH details a developer could forward manually are only a building block, and Zelle payments are a different feature.

support.subject: As a developer, linked accounts plug into my payment processor — documented integrations or token exchange that hand verified account credentials to third-party processors and platforms
